Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口明示允许在处置过程后保留限定材料。", "name": "explicit_retention_permission"}, {"meaning": "窗口明示禁止在处置过程后保留限定材料。", "name": "explicit_retention_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "窗口对不同材料或条件同时明示有限留存许可和留存禁止。", "name": "both_permission_and_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "完整供应窗口没有明示处置后留存许可或禁止；全量处置本身不改变此选择。", "name": "no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window"}], "examples": [], "name": "post_disposal_retention_effect_v1", "question": "判断供应窗口是否明示处置后的留存许可或留存禁止。不得仅因要求返还或销毁全部材料就称其为 explicit retention prohibition。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ”→explicit_retention_permission；“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”→explicit_retention_prohibition；“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and”→explicit_retention_permission；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_post_disposal_retention_effect_v1__28_31", "operation": "post_disposal_retention_effect_v1", "unit_ids": [28, 29, 30, 31], "current_units": [{"id": 28, "text": " Volunteer acknowledges and agrees that all Confidential Information and similar items whether maintained in hard copy, electronically or on-line relating to CCPDT’s business shall remain exclusively the property of the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers and shall only be used by Volunteer for the purpose(s) permitted by the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers."}, {"id": 29, "text": " Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service."}, {"id": 30, "text": "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed."}, {"id": 31, "text": "Volunteer Conflict of Interest  Volunteers shall avoid personal and professional conflicts of interest in all matters pertaining to the Certification program."}]}]}
